verdict.rationale: Ramp's reimbursements page says employees in 70+ countries can be paid in two days or less in their local currency. Employees can submit reimbursements through the CLI (`reimbursements submit`, list, pending) or request them via Ramp MCP, and the sandbox's "mark reimbursement as paid" action implies a status lifecycle through to payout. The core story is delivered, but tracking and the payout rail are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit direct-deposit/ACH wording, documentation of employee-facing status tracking from submission to payout, independent or hands-on corroboration of payout speed.
